propositions: committed lock pins transitive dependencies, causing future advisories against those pins to block every in-flight change regardless of whether the change touched the dependency
current pip-audit gate is unconditional and fails all changes equally, punishing authors of unrelated changes when an advisory is published against a pinned transitive dependency

override-dependencies is the correct instrument for escaping upstream caps, but constraint-dependencies and uv lock --upgrade-package are ineffective and commonly misapplied, causing wrong diagnostic conclusions
advisory gate must split by lane: block Gerrit verify only when a change touches the dependency map, but block releases always and escalate stale overrides via scheduled canary
retry logic only handles DB-unreachable failures, not real findings, but this limitation is invisible to users, making recheck the most time-wasting property
